fields.what: the ten runner fields on every line with the runner's types, and each arm's design fields

ids.what: every id unique and equal to the first 16 hex characters of the sha256 of its item's content

counts.what: items per arm and category; 50 sets of each combination of system prompt, layout and wording; repeats among the shown sets

budget.what: every price shown inside the budget that the request states

dominance.what: no identical profiles and no profile that dominates another in any set of arms 1 to 3

b_names_hidden.what: gate b on every names-hidden and unnamed prompt, with the pilot's names added to its deny list

c_no_scores.what: no utility or quality score or their words, no product named as the pick, no brand in the request

meta.what: the design fields equal what each prompt shows

twins.what: hidden twins, repeats, unnamed ratings and premium draws differ only in what their arm manipulates

balance.what: the balance table of the shown sets, each cell within 25 per cent of its expected count
